title: A choice becomes a passage
description: One seeded diagonal decision per cell becomes a four-by-four arrangement of walls.
limitation: One fixed seed and 16 cells; not every gap is connected.

title: Three fields, one height
description: Separate authored noise layers meet at the same addresses, then sum and undergo the source's slope pass.
limitation: A 25-by-25 display sampling over the 200 m source span; display scales are explicit, not a full terrain simulation.

title: A surface answers a view
description: Orbit a fixed torus while the source oil-slick shader answers the changing normal/view angle.
limitation: Source optical approximation, not physical thin-film simulation; only TIME is replaced by the film clock.

title: A generation becomes a storey
description: A three-neighbour birth is revealed, then actual Life states stack vertically as retained time.
limitation: A declared eight-by-eight wrapped glider fixture; later walker erosion is excluded.

title: Twenty of twenty-seven
description: Separate 27 cells, remove the source's seven omitted positions, and repeat the retained-index rule.
limitation: Two finite subdivision depths, not an infinite sponge.

title: Forward is a local direction
description: Follow the actual 3D Hilbert turtle segments through two rewrites and around a spatial orbit.
limitation: Finite generations; marker points along the current segment, rather than claiming to expose an unrecorded full turtle frame.

title: Which requests make the next branch?
description: Show real target assignments, unit directions, their normalized sum, and the resulting network growth.
limitation: One authored asymmetric field with NETWORK policy and a finite node/iteration budget.

title: A sheet is held by relations
description: Reveal the actual membrane's pins and distance constraints while replaying a computed grip and release.
limitation: Educational membrane, not measured fabric; six seconds of actual fixed-step solver output slowed for inspection.
